subject: Air freight quote: FRA to ORD
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from FRA (Frankfurt) to ORD (Chicago, US)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-27, and we will deliver it to FRA ourselves.

The shipment consists of 8 pieces of printed marketing material, with a gross weight of 1076 kg and a total volume of 4.83 cbm.

Please include the all-in price in EUR and the earliest available departure and arrival times.

Thank you for your assistance.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a specific shipment from FRA to ORD.
